description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Donnie & April, adding one mana of any color.
When Donnie & April dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Donnie & April from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Donnie & April from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.
